auditor: Claude (independent of the GPT-authored code under review; not an external human reviewer)

baseline.note: Handoff named 1301c3ed as baseline; main had advanced to f754209 (PR #18 handoff package) at audit time.

defects.summary: 2026 annual transit total 12,300 manufactured by annualising 1,315 transits over 1 Jan–8 Feb 2026 (39 days) and fed into the historical chart, the 2015→2026 cumulative headline and the print report.
defects.repro: On f754209: open Historical tab or print report with year 2026; allYears('SG-RTM') ends with {yr:2026, tot:12300}.
defects.expected: No full-year value for a year without a complete official annual total (hard rule 2).
defects.actual: ≈22.1 MtCO2 of modelled avoided emissions attributed to 2026 (cumulative ≈391.6 Mt instead of ≈369.5 Mt for 2015–2025); value also stale vs Oct 2026 = 1,490 transits in a single month.
defects.fix: Y[2026]={t:null,incomplete:true}; seriesYears() filters; print report falls back to latest complete year with explicit note.
defects.test: tests/smoke.mjs (asserts no 12,300, series ends 2025, cumulative = sum of series, print note). Verified to FAIL on f754209 and PASS on fix.

defects.summary: GitHub Pages deploys on every push to main (pages.yml) and from the hourly AIS job (publish-status) without running any test.
defects.repro: .github/workflows/pages.yml had a single deploy job with no needs/test step.
defects.expected: Deploy only after green tests (hard rule 9).
defects.fix: test job (npm ci && npm test) + deploy needs: test; publish-status runs npm ci && npm test before upload.
defects.test: Workflow-level; validated by PR CI run.

defects.summary: npm test ran only the jsdom smoke check; 56 node --test unit tests were split across workflows that do not gate deployment.
defects.fix: npm test = syntax checks + smoke + all unit suites (ais-lab, src, sca-stats, backend, tests).

defects.summary: Engine and four UIs hard-wired to period 2026-10 / 1,490 vessels / 'October'. The next SCA monthly release cannot be ingested without code edits; pages would show 'Source failed validation' or stale October text.
defects.repro: Change data period to 2026-11 → analyzeAnnouncements throws 'Unexpected reporting periods'.
defects.expected: Any announced month ingestible; baseline cross-checked against official monthly table.
defects.fix: Engine fixed (any YYYY-MM vs same month prior year; baseline must equal annual-report month; publication date ≥ period). STILL OPEN in UI: index.html:1673-1709, official-statistics.html:35-38 and 101-117, decision-room.html:88-116 hardcode October/1490.
defects.test: src/official-traffic-insights.test.mjs (SYNTHETIC November record, conflict and period-mismatch rejection).

defects.summary: Passage start = first sighting in the approach zone, so 'elapsedHours' includes anchorage waiting (often days) and is not canal transit time; 48 h limit then discards long-waiting but genuine transits.
defects.fix: Use backend/transit-fsm.mjs semantics (lower/upper canal-time bounds from last approach fix / first canal fix) in the Lab, or relabel as 'zone-to-zone elapsed'.
defects.test: backend/transit-fsm.test.mjs covers the corrected semantics; Lab not yet changed.

defects.summary: At audit time the 'hourly' workflow had zero schedule-triggered runs; data/ais-quality-history.json holds 3 samples taken 09:09–09:21Z by push/dispatch runs (two within the same UTC hour).
defects.expected: Evidence of ≥24 scheduled runs before any 24 h statement.
defects.actual: Schedule unproven (workflow created the same morning).
defects.fix: None in code; re-check scheduled runs after 24 h. Existing collectionRunRatio stays null until window mature (correct).

defects.summary: Comment said B20/tree values 'continue to increase with time' while code anchors them; misleading for maintainers.
Canal zone = 13 km buffer around a coarse centreline; includes Port Said, East Port Said and Ismailia berths/lake areas; approach boxes are not chart-derived.
defects.fix: Replace with SCA/IHO-validated polygons and version them (geofence_version).
defects.test: backend tests flag LONG_DWELL / CANAL_VISIT for port calls.

defects.summary: index.html calls /api/vessel which worker.js does not implement (always 404), then falls back to Wikidata (crowd-sourced). Particulars must remain labelled unverified.
defects.fix: Remove dead call or implement a licensed lookup server-side; keep 'wikidata-live' label.

defects.summary: AIS-quality and archive-watch workflows push bot commits directly to main, bypassing PR review (aggregate data only, no secrets).
defects.fix: Optional: write to a data branch or the Pages artifact only.

defects.summary: Annual comparison hard-wired to 2024 vs 2025; will need edit when the 2026 annual report is published.
defects.fix: Derive latest two complete years from data.annual.

defects.summary: Streaming mode drops late (out-of-order) fixes; replay mode sorts first.
defects.fix: 2–5 min watermark reorder buffer in the collector.

notDefects: Daily/monthly KPI on V9 historical years is labelled '÷365 days' / '÷12' modelled average — transparent, not a manufactured traffic total.
Voyage model preserves negative avoided emissions (checked: Suez longer case → −93.6 tCO2).
WtW is blocked in the route comparator; 'ammonia or hydrogen do not mean zero' text present.
No credentials or AIS identities/positions found in tracked files; service worker is network-only.
